headline: Mooring County and Weathered Expanse Strongpoints Shift in Latest Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County has turned another Colonial strongpoint to Warden control; the ledger now reads eleven Warden posts to one Colonial, with Gravekeeper's Holdfast, The Cut, and Wiccwalk drawing the most event traffic. Weathered Expanse now stands five Warden to four Colonial, the neutral hold from the earlier report gone, after repeated exchanges at Crow's Nest and Frostmarch; its 24-hour casualty totals exceed ten thousand on each side, though two-hour rates are cooling. Palantine Berm lists six Warden posts against one Colonial, but Leiri Hermanni registered six changes, the latest at 22:10. LinnMercy, wholly Colonial, recorded a fresh three-event exchange at Rotdust shortly before midnight. Stlican Shelf remains six Colonial to three Warden, without neutral ground, while Nevish Line shows one Colonial post among seven Warden, with Grief Mother the focus of its activity. Callahans Passage stands all-Warden and Farranac Coast all-Colonial, with strongpoint events quiet there. No conquest has been declared.
